title: Analysis code and results for lineage-selective cancer dependencies from DepMap 26Q1

creators.name: Liu, Yanxun
creators.affiliation: Zaozhuang Maternal and Child Health Hospital, Zaozhuang, China

creators.name: Li, Shanshan
creators.affiliation: Zaozhuang Mining Group Central Hospital, Zaozhuang, China

description: Code, intermediate results, figures and supporting tables for the manuscript 'A selectivity-based analytical strategy for identifying lineage-selective cancer dependencies from DepMap data'. The current analysis uses DepMap 26Q1, 1,192 cancer cell lines and 467,091 gene-lineage tests, yielding 94 prioritised pairs. Input datasets are public but are not included in this archive; download instructions and input-file checksums are in the README.
